# LEADs with `line` `nucleating-argument`

*Lines of inquiry — A named line of the record's own argument, so that a line can be set aside as a whole and what depends on it can be found. Retracting a line is a status change on its members, never a deletion (ADR-032).*

**Nucleating an argument** — how an argument developed across stateless sessions settles into stable, addressable structure — what drifts, what anchors it, and what anchoring costs. What a record of it keeps, and the record as its own apparatus, are lines of their own (ADR-082).

| [LEAD-213](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-213.md) | Judge retention and drift by triangulating three probe families, a mechanical retention measure, blind model raters and the owner on a subsample, and count a finding only where they agree | Alternative (b) of two for the judgement [LEAD-201](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-201.md) and [LEAD-204](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-204.md) leave open: it takes [CLAIM-206](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-206.md)'s side of [ARG-028](../../../record/arguments.d/ARG-028.md), that human judgement is one probe family among others, and so asks several families for the same judgement and believes only their agreement. (1) A mechanical retention measure fixed in advance: the share of the originating turn's content words and of its quoted phrases recovered in each version, against a shuffled-turn baseline. (2) Model raters given only the turn and the version, blind to the hypothesis and to which version is which, scoring the same content units as alternative (a)'s rubric. (3) The owner, on a random subsample. A claim of retention or of drift is counted only where all three agree; disagreement is reported as a finding about the probes. The assistant can run (1) alone, and (2) with the caveat that a Claude rater shares the record's conventions ([CLAIM-266](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-266.md)). The other alternative is [LEAD-214](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-214.md). The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Open |
